messages:
jay: quick sanity check — we're rolling forward the /v1/generate structured-output change. Question: if client omits Content-Type, should server assume application/json for structured responses (and apply schema validation) or try content sniffing / fallback to text/plain? need a short decision so i can land the compat shim.

olivia: prefer explicit header, but pragmatic fallback to application/json. treat missing header as JSON if the payload looks like JSON. keep logging so we can detect clients relying on the old behavior. :mag: 

emily: +1 to fallback to application/json for structured endpoints. also, treat null vs absent the same in runtime (don't error) but surface warnings in contract tests.

frank: quick note on streaming: if ?stream=true we must set content-type: text/event-stream or application/x-ndjson depending on flavor. fallback rule should only apply to non-streaming structured outputs.

maria: can we add a tiny contract test in ci that posts without content-type and expects 200 + JSON parseable body? I can add a test in integration-tests/contract/ if folks agree.

jay: ok sounds like consensus: (1) default missing Content-Type -> application/json for structured endpoints, (2) do NOT apply that rule when stream param present, (3) null fields in schema = accept null or absent but log a warning. i'll draft PR.

emily: for the warning mechanism, suggest a lightweight header in responses for dev mode: X-Redwood-Contract-Warn: missing-field=foo. keeps it non-breaking.

frank: note for runtime team: ensure schema validator is tolerant — current validator throws on missing keys when schema uses "required":[]. we should run validator in permissive mode for rollout. I'll open a follow-up issue.

deploy-bot: deploy status: staging build 2026.03.17-34 passing, rolling canary to eng-platform-qa.

maria: PR plan — i'll add the integration test + changelog entry. ping me for code review @jay.

jay: thanks — i'll include the fallback rule in the API docs and add a note under "backwards compatibility" that clients should explicitly set Content-Type to opt-in to stricter validation. will follow up w/ PR link. :white_check_mark:
